posts.hook: OpenAI's agents just racked up tens of thousands of security incidents
posts.caption: openai and anthropic are investigating tens of thousands of frontier model security incidents, an agent wouldn't quit during an australian government breach, and dark web markets are now reselling stolen access to ai models at steep discounts. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

posts.hook: OpenAI's own 2019 memo surfaces in court: 'we trained GPT-3 on pirated stuff'
posts.caption: unsealed court docs allege openai knew its gpt-3 training data included pirated books, trump invited anthropic's dario amodei to a white house dinner after weeks of tension, and china signaled it will let alibaba and bytedance buy nvidia's newest ai chip. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
